# dayloop v0.12.0-rc5 — calendar marker and motion review build

This prerelease is an installable candidate for checking the revised P5R completion treatments, calendar interaction, marker placement, and contrast on a real device.

## What changed since rc4

- Changed Perfect Day text to black.
- Restored white text on Tasks, End day, and Achievements this month.
- Enlarged the centered End day label while retaining the thick date display face.
- Set the Perfect Day and Day Complete holds to two seconds.
- Extended the Day Complete transition to 0.8 seconds total: 400 ms cover and 400 ms reveal.
- Made Day Complete take priority when both completion treatments are triggered together.
- Removed the month-opener and section artwork beside the Calendar month heading while preserving the heading's exact layout footprint.
- Changed P5R Confidant list names to white and supporting rank/route/date text to red.
- Reused the month-opener graphic as the deadline-due marker and moved section graphics to their derived section-start dates.
- Added horizontal swipe gestures for previous/next Calendar months while retaining the arrow controls.
- Changed Today's deadline title to black and the days-left line to red.

## What to check

- Complete every task, then immediately tap End day: only Day Complete should remain visible.
- Confirm Perfect Day and the readable Day Complete hold each last about two seconds; the Day Complete cover/reveal should total about 0.8 seconds.
- Compare End day with rc4 and confirm its label is larger, centered, and white.
- Check Calendar months with differently sized artwork sets: the month heading must not move or stretch after the header graphics disappear.
- Swipe left and right across Calendar; one deliberate swipe should move one month, while vertical scrolling should remain usable.
- Confirm deadline due dates use the month-opener art instead of red square markers and section artwork appears inside its relevant starting date cell.
- Inspect the Confidants list and Today's deadline card for the flipped white/red and black/red contrast.

## Candidate APK notes

- This APK is **not production-signed**. It uses Android's standard debug signing key for hands-on testing.
- Its application id is `com.shadowmonarchbooks.dayloop.candidate`, so it can be installed alongside the production Dayloop app.
- Its profiles, progress, and settings are separate from the stable app.
- Version: `0.12.0-rc5` (`versionCode 18`).

_Fan-made tool, not affiliated with or endorsed by ATLUS/SEGA._
